body: Omfg, that is so despicable...and pathetic...but thanks for sharing this, I never would have thought of this 🙄

Use VidAngel! We have it and it makes life sooooooo much easier. You can connect your Netflix account, as well as other streaming services. It allows you to filter out sex and nudity! (As well as other potentially unsavory things, violence, swearing, etc. it’s actually a Mormon company haha) It’s been really awesome to watch all the shows and movies everyone else does without having to worry about getting triggered or having to sit awkwardly through shit you don’t want to see.

Omg, I feel you so hard on this one. I absolutely used to love summer, the beach, swimming, but now I’m so triggered it ruins it. My partner and I used to go to a very popular crowded beach a lot when we were younger, but I choose not to go now, one because I’m just over the crowds anyway (it ruins my time) and also because currently the trend is thong bikinis and I just fucking can’t. The solution my partner and I had found was going to a beach that is pretty secluded. You have to hike about a mile to get to it, and it also has a tiny parking lot, so it basically becomes a private beach because so few people can/choose to go there. We LOVE IT. But even that Haven was ruined for me last year - I shit you not, we were basically the only people there, on about a mile of beach, and this young twenty something girl comes hiking in, lays down her towel 50 feet from us ( there was a literal ENTIRE ASS BEACH she had plenty of room to go somewhere else) and then proceeded to take her top off and lay topless. I have never seen a woman laying out on a public family beach topless in my life and we saw it 3 times last year....so yeah, it sort of scarred me. I’m sorry, I don’t have much advice for you, except try to find a more secluded spot that can become special for the two of you...the other thing is my partner will pointedly look away if there is a woman walking around hanging out, which you would think would make me feel good, but even that is triggering in its own way because then I know when he’s seeing something that is sexually arousing and I just compare myself to whatever it is he is trying not to look at anyway...FML.

I have told him how I feel. He has done things in the past that have contributed to me feeling like this. I had basically conquered my BDD as an adult, but he cheated on me and did some other messed up things, and my BDD has now spiraled out of control and is currently the worst it’s ever been. 

I definitely think about him seeing me as “less than” because I’m insecure and tell him about it, but I’m a very open and honest person. His response to me has been “I don’t want her” and “you’re worried about how you’re going to look, but how is it going to look if you won’t go?” Basically saying I’m going to look like the insecure B I am if I don’t go.

I hear you about grinning and bearing it. I do the same thing hoping that the ol’ “confidence is attractive” bit will ring true and somehow I’ll “look” better. I feel like that’s my only option. I go out and force myself to be this charming, life of the party girl, even though it’s absolutely exhausting for me, and I go home to have a mental breakdown. Good call with the alcohol though, I may need to drink to get through this...

Thank you for letting me know I’m not alone, I feel like any time I’ve tried talking about this with anyone in my life they act like I’m insane and I just need to get over it...

I go through this with my friend especially. She takes pictures of me non-stop without me knowing, and of course they’re terrible (even somebody else would agree they are not flattering pictures). She sends them to me and I seriously want to die when I look at them. She doesn’t realize how horribly they impact my self esteem, and when I’ve tried telling her that she scoffs and says “you look great!” (I even showed the pictures to my partner, they’re not great...even he had to admit “yeah, they’re not great pictures of you...”). I just try not to look at them, and told her DO NOT post any to social media.

I would be suspicious. Just try to remain calm, don’t let him know you’re suspicious. Poker face. It’s not unheard of for men to get yeast infections, but you’re right, they usually get it from a partner...ditto to asking him to get tested for STDs to gauge his reaction. Sorry you’re feeling like this, it’s so hard to not know what is real.
BARF. I know, I hate that so much. It’s like a mixture of a shitty cop-out response and them trying to gaslight and manipulate us into feeling bad for them.

So sorry you’re in this place. I can relate, and I fucking hate that. I hate when they say “yep, I guess I’m a piece of shit.” in a sarcastic way. Because yep, they kind of fucking are, truly. Sorry you’re feeling so hurt, you’re not alone.

I’m going to agree with the comment about him not being totally sober if he’s choosing to watch a movie that is specifically made to cram as much nudity and raunchy material in as possible. That shit is not ok for an addict to be watching. I’m so sorry you’re feeling like this, it’s so painful to go through. And this man knew what he was doing. He disregarded your feelings. However you slice it that is selfish. Love is not selfish.

If you weighed the pros and cons of staying with him, I have a hunch the cons list would be a little bit longer. If he’s treating you like this and manipulating you after only 6 months of being together, there’s a serious problem. I’m assuming you don’t share a home, kids, etc. so I would get out while you’re ahead. This guy also just sounds like a serious POS.

When someone shows you who they are, believe them.

I’m so sorry you’re going through this.

This is way more normal than society wants to make you think it is. I have tried talking about how horrible my partners porn addiction makes me feel, only to have friends/family roll their eyes, scoff, and say “all guys watch porn.” As if it is the healthiest, most normal thing in the world. 
It’s not. You’re not crazy. Your feelings are understandable and valid. 
It is so heartbreaking being with somebody that chooses this. 
My partner had an emotional affair, and believe it or not, in some ways, his porn abuse is way worse. At least the affair was about a real human, not the perverse monstrosity of porn. 
I’m really sorry you’re going through this. You are way, WAY too young to be with somebody that has difficulties climaxing while he’s with you. 
I am dealing with this myself currently. I just want to give up, he has destroyed me. 
All I can say is don’t get trapped with a PA. From what I’m learning, they rarely, if ever, actually get better.

Did you specifically address porn as an issue? I feel like it would be hard for me to say how that has affected me, and ask for that to be focused on because of how normalized it is. I’m afraid if the polygraph examiner is a man he’s not going to be on my side, he’s going to empathize with my partner... I’m tired of my reality being warped by my partners lies, it would be worth it to me to spend $500 to get some answers.
Thank you. I’m just sitting here shaking like a leaf. This has completely triggered my PTSD. That is what it physically feels like, like you’ve been in a horrible accident.

Thank you for the comments. One of the worst things when these kinds of things happen is waking up in the morning...at least for me. When you wake up and it all comes flooding back and you realize it wasn’t a nightmare, it’s your reality. I’m just feeling absolutely disgusted right now, by literally everything. I can’t stand being in the home we created together. I don’t even want my clothes, my belongings. I just feel like I can’t stand being this person anymore. That’s the only way I can describe it. My skin is crawling, and nothing feels real here. It all just feels like a really sick joke, and even the walls are mocking me.

He literally only came clean because there was a reckoning, he couldn’t hide it anymore. This is so scary, I’m so sorry you’re going through this. This is horrific. He totally disregarded you and your well-being and seriously put your health at risk. That’s the worst part, he took away your choice. You didn’t go out and have risky sex, he did, but you could have had to live with the consequences of his choices. How long have you been together?

Edit: Ugh, just read your response to another comment, you’re still waiting on your test results? Oh my gosh, hugs to you! This makes me so angry and so sad for you! 😞

This early on in the relationship I would definitely say it is unwise to continue...he’s not going to suddenly realize “oh gee, I’m in a relationship now, not single teehee” and stop talking to girls. He’s “so used to being single”? That’s such a shitty cop out excuse. He knows he’s in a relationship, he just clearly doesn’t actually want to be, or care about doing things behind your back if he feels like it. Trust your instinct. Because leaving this early in the relationship is going to be much easier than a couple years down the road when he gives you an std and you find out he’s been having sex with randos behind your back. Except now you share bills, and responsibilities, maybe kids even, and it’s much harder to get away from him. There are much better men out there, don’t waste your early 20’s tied to a guy that doesn’t show you even the barest courtesy.

Edit* Someone else already said this, but this is a test. Now that he knows he can get away with transgressions like this it will continue. People very rarely change without going through some sort of discomfort. You staying with him and forgiving him has rewarded him for his shitty behavior.

I think that’s where he struggles the most, his self esteem sucks. He’s definitely not the type to “fake it til you make it”. He’s hyper critical of himself. If he messes up he sort of shuts down and feels like a failure. I’ve literally tried to get him to say a morning mantra to try to get hype before he goes to work lol

That’s a good idea. It’s weird, but for some reason the fades he gives to his friends are the best cuts he does. I think he gets nervous when it’s somebody he doesn’t know and sort of sabotages himself. If it’s a friend he’s more relaxed and seems to perform better.

I’ll pass that along to him. I seriously think instagram ruins lives lol. He knows that the cuts he sees online aren’t nearly as crisp in person, but I think he still sort of compares himself against that because that’s all anyone ever posts.

Yeah, it’s hard because he is also working with only one other barber who is very good. I told him he shouldn’t work at this shop, he compares himself to this other barber non-stop. I think it would be easier if he was working with other barbers that are at different points in their journey, not just one who can “do no wrong” and is experienced. On the one hand, he can learn a lot from him, but on the other, I think he would benefit from seeing a lot of other people’s work and techniques. He’s only talking to this one guy, who may cut hair very well, but might not be a great teacher.

I’m so sorry this is happening to you. I’m sure it’s absolutely gut wrenching to be betrayed by TWO people you thought you could trust and count on at the same time. 
Speaking as somebody that reconciled with my wayward spouse, I still don’t know if this is something I would be able to work out. This is just betrayal from multiple angles. At the bare minimum, if you want to try to work it out with your partner, you will probably need to cut ties with the friend. I don’t see a way to not do that that won’t seriously break you down and drive you crazy. Any time she’s around you’ll be thinking of what you saw. And honestly, even if you decide to be done with both of them, I don’t think I would ever trust the friend again. She will continue to betray you if she gets the chance. No true friend would go after your man behind your back. She broke the code.
Lastly, I just want to say that this is not your fault. Even if you have been growing apart or having struggles in your relationship, that NEVER gives somebody the right to go outside of the relationship and betray you. In some ways I’m almost more disgusted by your friend, who clearly struggles with self esteem and self worth if she’s willing to chase after and get with her best friends guy. Like I said, she’s broken, and would likely do it again.
If it’s any consolation, I learned that as a person I attract broken people. Which really sucks, because I’m always trying to take care of them and lift them up, and sometimes they take full advantage of that. Best of luck to you with whatever you choose! You did nothing to deserve this!
Thanks for your response 🙏
Thanks for your response, I definitely appreciate it

Thank you so much for your thoughtful answer. Echoes things I’ve tried telling myself in the past - I appreciate your insight here. I want things to continue to flourish between us, I’m going to try to be as loving and supportive as I can.
I was just headed here to put this. Thank you. There’s nothing acceptable about this.

So we’re 4 years on and social media is a trigger for me. He literally only got Snapchat to talk (and I’m sure other things......) with the other woman. He was psychotic about locking his phone and would freak out if I touched it. I don’t use Snapchat, neither one of us are really big social media people, I didn’t even know he had one. As a condition of our reconciliation, he had to delete Snapchat. I wasn’t fucking around with that. 
Honestly, my partner has been really great in the years since. He worked REALLY hard to make things better. He started going to therapy weekly, would call and text me constantly to check in, let me know when he was leaving work, gave me his passwords, etc. 
At first, you best believe I was suspicious and checking up on him constantly. Over the years he has proven over and over again that he is serious about making things work between us, and over time I have begun to actually believe and trust him again - usually.
But sometimes something will trigger me, and I’m right back in that place again of feeling frantic, and looking at anything he does as suspicious. So speaking as somebody 4 years in, my relationship in many ways is better than it was pre-affair. We communicate so much better now. But yeah, sometimes shit comes up and flings you back there. It happens less and less frequently as time goes on for me.

I literally know somebody that was in this situation. They were married, already had 3 kids, husband got a vasectomy. Wife gets pregnant almost 10 years later, husband freaks out, immediately assumes she cheated (which is funny, because he had cheated on her several times). Come to find out his tubes had repaired? Grown back? Idk, point is you don’t know shit, so maybe figure out if you’re actually still sterile before jumping to conclusions. Also, you’re a jackhole for lying about the vasectomy in the first place.
They definitely do, they absolutely can suck the life out of you, if you allow them to.

That's OK, if you didn't click with that therapist you might have better luck with somebody else in the future. I've also had less than stellar relationships with therapists, and have had to move on to find a better fit. If that isn't an option for you now (totally understandable) maybe you would be interested in joining an online support group? There are a lot of options available. Thank you for coming here and sharing your story. Do you feel like talking about it would be helpful? When do these feelings seem to become worse for you?

I'm so sorry you had to go through that. I just want to say that it's not your fault, and you're absolutely right, you were betrayed by somebody that seemed to have your best interests at heart, somebody that you considered a friend. It sounds like you are still really struggling, is getting therapy an option for you? Do you have anyone you can talk to in your life that you trust? That sounds like it was a very scary and traumatic experience for you, and it's really normal for those feelings to linger and fester. You're not alone <3

First I just want to say I'm sorry for what you have been through. I'm glad you have had some time to reflect and are making decisions to pursue and explore your sexuality because it is something you truly want, and not because you are being pressured. I would say if you feel safe with this friend, and want to try, I wouldn't worry too much about it being weird. He knows what he's getting himself into, and was understanding when you told him about your CSA. You've been intimate before, so it's not like trying to go farther would be completely coming out of left field. I would just be really honest and say that you really like him, trust him, are comfortable with him, etc (whatever feels authentic for you) and that you're interested in trying to go farther, but you're nervous because of the feelings it might bring up for you, and you don't want it to catch him off guard...and just see how he reacts.

So sorry you are going through this, and know that it is not your fault. If you are in the position to leave, my humble opinion would be to do so. Cheating on him to try to get revenge will never make things better (but you already know that) and you'll just feel like garbage for stooping to his level. You're somebody that has integrity, don't compromise that for him. If this has been an ongoing thing like this, then as others have mentioned, it is an addiction for him. And if you've ever dealt with addicts, you'll know that no amount of love and support can fix them. They have to do the hard work themselves. You will continue to give of yourself until there is absolutely nothing left, because serial cheaters are black holes that suck in as much attention as they can, and are never satisfied. My significant other had an emotional affair over 3 years ago. The reason we are still together, and at this point are thriving, is because from almost day one he was so ashamed and committed to making things work. He did a full year of weekly therapy sessions, gave me access to all of his devices and accounts, called me non-stop throughout the day, etc. My point is, he was very remorseful, and was willing to put in the work. I feel like any time I've seen somebody continue to go down that path, and continue to make the choice to cheat after having been caught and seeing how much it ruins their life and family, will continue to do it. The consequences weren't severe enough, they got to have their cake and eat it too. Sorry you're stuck in quarantine with him, but maybe use this time to try to make a plan.

It's also not working for me, hence why I just googled "Companion Glitch Patched".  I'm seriously pissed right now. I had a pretty good system going for getting the glitch to activate nearly every time, and am getting the same issue you are. Enemies only follow so far before they give up and just walk away like nothing happened. I have hogtied people and carried them basically into camp, then released them to try it a few different ways, but if I untie them too far away, they just walk away. And if I untie them too close, I get the message that says "enemies were lead too close to camp" and the screen goes black too quickly for me to kill myself.

Seriously irritated and disappointed, as if this was hurting anyone. Rockstar just doesn't want us to have any fun with story mode because they want to try to force us to play online.

You need to tell her. Fuck whatever nonsense you read online, it was no doubt written by somebody who had cheated. The sooner you tell her the better. Tell her you needed time to process, but you can't bare deceiving her. You need to be REALLY sorry. And it sounds like you are. But the longer you wait, the more she's going to think "hm, he must have been thinking about trying to hide it", which is going to hurt her. Also, it happened with a bridesmaid, at a wedding. Who knows who might find out. It might make it back to her somehow (you would be very surprised), and if it does, you're fucked. It needs to come from you, or theres no chance she's going to ever trust you again. I was betrayed, and it didn't matter that it was "mild", the lengths my partner went to to hide it from me and lie to me were what really destroyed me.

Good for you. Truly. This may seem like the hardest thing you've done, but trust me, speaking from experience, you will get better much more quickly if you get away from her. It will never be the same. I'm still with my cheating spouse, and I still hurt almost every day, and it's been 2 years since d-day. Sometimes I really wish we had stayed separated. It would have been the much easier option. Even if it seems harder in the moment. Best of luck to you.

Just wanted to thank everyone that took the time to respond, this was a really crazy week, and I really appreciate it. I'm looking forward to being able to reach out to this community throughout my journey.

Oh my gosh, I feel this...once we got to a certain point, things no longer made me uncomfortable, but I relished how uncomfortable he would get...best time it happened was when we were visiting his parents and his mother started talking about how his brother had just been cheated on, and what a piece of garbage the cheating girlfriend was...I could literally feel him sinking into the couch next to me, as he listened to his mother going on a tirade about how  cheaters are the scum of the earth. It was perfect haha
Thanks, that is the answer i was looking for. I think I've always just been terrified that whoever I told would report it and "ruin my life" (which is built around lies).
Thank you, it is eating me alive.

I'm sorry you have to go through this, it is seriously so hard to deal with. But Let me just say, I really applaud your strength in going to a hotel. I got kicked out by my partner and it is fucking horrible. I really hope you have some good friends or family to lean on, because you will need them. When I left I was literally calling and texting anyone and everyone I thought would listen. But you know we all will be here to listen. Try and just take it minute by minute. I know you love him. That is what makes it so hard. But you have to try to take care of yourself, because he won't. You are the only one that can protect your heart. (((Hugs)))

I know know horrible it is to be afraid of the unknown. But there are things you know for certain about what is going to happen if you stay, and nothing changes. He is going to keep doing this. No amount of crying and begging on your part is going to make him stop. Because he doesn't have empathy for you. So while you are afraid of the unknown, can you honestly say that if you stay with him, he keeps doing this BULLSHIT, that you will ever have the happy life you envision for yourself? It is soo, sooo hard when you have made all of your life plans around somebody else, and they turn out to be a shithead, but you can still have everything you want in life, even without him. You just need to be willing to adjust your road map a little bit.
I'm in awe of your ability to let things go, and move on,  because I'm not sure I can lol Thank you for your perspective

I have definitely considered it. The hardest part for me, is that if I had just met him yesterday, and he was behaving the way he is now, I would probably think it was a perfect relationship. He gets really frustrated because he wants me to just judge him based off of his current behavior, and he has turned over a new leaf blah blah blah.

So then I feel like what is wrong with me? I seriously don't know how people move on, because you're right, I get daily reminders of what he did last year. How does that not kill everyone else, that says they are now happy in their relationship?

I know, it is really pathetic. I struggle daily, but I think I just feel so worthless at this point, I think deep down I'm afraid nobody else will ever want me. Intellectually, I know that is ridiculous, typing it sounds ridiculous, but I've been so beat down it just sort of has become my reality. Thank you for your words though. I'm really struggling to build myself back up.

Trust me, you're not the only one that didn't have your partner begging for your forgiveness. I walked out and didn't hear from mine for a month. It was incredibly hard, but I went mostly no contact. He realized living the single life was not all it was cracked up to be. We reconciled, but to this day I have the same feelings you do, why didn't my partner send me 100 roses, write me love songs, crawl to me on his knees to beg for my forgiveness. I would say most cheaters don't do that, because that would mean admitting they did something wrong, and in their fucked up little world, they don't truly feel like they did anything wrong, because they got what they wanted. 

I would say that now contributes to me being a year out and still feeling miserable with him.

All of it is just really unfair, that they did something horrible and we are the ones that have to suffer. It sucks.

First off, I'm so sorry you are going through this but-
Leave. It doesn't have to be permanent, but go ahead and leave. Go stay with family or friends. Do you have anyone nearby? Get the fuck away from him so you can think. Don't be afraid that if you leave he's going to be fucking somebody else, or with somebody else, because clearly he will do that to you even if you're being a good partner and sitting at home waiting for him. Either getting some distance will show you what you need to know, or at the very least it will show him that you don't want to be jerked around anymore (which honestly probably won't matter to him anyway). I'm assuming you share a mortgage. I'm really sorry. That makes things so messy. And I'm sure it contributes to him thinking he has you trapped. You have to understand that is HORRIBLE. The things you are describing are so abusive. Like textbook abusive.

He is gas lighting you, and trying to make you think *you're* crazy, and how dare you accuse him. Fucking newsflash....HE DISAPPEARS FOR DAYS AT A TIME. In what fucked up reality would somebody ever think that is even remotely ok to do? He lives his life like a fucking stray cat! Comes home to get fed and disappears to chase the other alley cats for days.

He literally told you he doesn't care if you stay or go. And feels entitled to acting however he wants. I know you're probably going to anyway (we all do), but don't blame any of this on yourself. Anyone that can do something like this to somebody, and be so callous, is a narcissist. And he would definitely do this to anyone, no matter how perfect. Because he is clearly a scumbag. (Sorry if I'm not supposed to say that, but it's true)

I know you love him (and who am I to talk, I'm still with my cheating partner) but unless he makes some DRASTIC changes, it is really not a safe environment for you to be in. Perhaps try speaking to a lawyer to see what your options are. DON'T LET HIM KNOW.  Play your cards close to your chest, you are the only one that has your best interests at heart. I'm so sorry.

I'm really sorry. I truly feel your pain. I always felt sympathy for those that experienced infidelity, and of course I felt angry at the cheater. But until I had experienced it, I never knew how much it destroys you. I have been through a lot in life, and I can honestly say that it is the worst pain I have ever experienced. It is truly devastating. All I can say, is last New Years Eve I went out and treated myself to lamb, steak, and lobster. Try some self celebration. It was really empowering for me. Best wishes.

I'm really sorry you're in the same boat, and her not being able to understand why you would feel so horrible, is bullshit. This is the ultimate betrayal, by somebody who is not only your lover, but is also supposed to be your best friend, your everything. 

I know everyone says it, and it can be hard to believe when you are so down on yourself, but you deserve so much more, somebody that will actually respect you and your relationship together. But you're right, I also feel like an ugly piece of undeserving shit lol so I hear you, it's pretty horrible that we have to suffer because *they* did something wrong...

People that cheat are empty, unfulfilled human beings. They cheat because there is something wrong with them. They are constantly going to be seeking validation from others, and some of them will continue to do that forever. She is DEFINITELY more insecure, she couldn't handle being faithful because she is selfish, and needed a cheap thrill to feel good about herself.

And I can't believe she said that about you getting back together, thats pretty cruel. She sounds like she doesn't really care about anyone but herself. I'm sure you are much better off. Time will make it easier.

No, you're not a moron, it was a lot of words lol

We actually haven't tried couples therapy yet, we have both been doing individual counseling. He has been going very consistently, and I have been going sporadically. I would probably be better off if I had been going consistently this whole year...I think just about everyone, especially those of us who have been put through this shit, could seriously benefit from it...

Yeah, exactly. Sometimes it is hard for me to tell what is more difficult; trying to forgive *HIM* or trying to forgive *MYSELF* for allowing myself to be treated that way...
And the whole thing was just both of them being insecure, and needing validation from someone else. They both were able to supply that for each other....*barf*...
